name: openarise-desktop
description: Local Python development with controlled execution and project intelligence.

scripts.build: npm run typecheck && vite build && node scripts/build-electron.mjs
scripts.test:real: npm run build && electron tests/electron-real-flow.cjs && electron tests/electron-real-reopen.cjs
scripts.package:win:dir: npm run build && node scripts/prepare-windows-runtime.mjs && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --win dir --x64
scripts.package:win: npm run build && node scripts/prepare-windows-runtime.mjs && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --win nsis --x64
scripts.package:win:portable: npm run build && node scripts/prepare-windows-runtime.mjs && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --win portable --x64
scripts.package:win:zip: npm run build && node scripts/prepare-windows-runtime.mjs && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --win zip --x64
scripts.package:win:msi: npm run build && node scripts/prepare-windows-runtime.mjs && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --win msi --x64
